## What's new

Threadnote 5.2.0-beta.2 makes background operations visible throughout Manager and shows when graph snapshots were created or updated.

- **See active operations from any page:** Manager's footer shows running work and opens Processes for details. It shares live status with Processes and respects reduced-motion preferences.
- **Know how recent a graph snapshot is:** graph administration shows live Created and Updated ages, with exact timestamps available on hover.
- **Keep project cards compact:** cards use their natural height instead of stretching to match the tallest card.
- **Read older Context Health checkpoints safely:** checkpoints from older semantic analyzers show partial coverage until refreshed, without crashing or presenting old progress as current completion.

[Full changelog since beta 1](https://github.com/threadnote/threadnote/compare/v5.2.0-beta.1...v5.2.0-beta.2)
